in_marathi.name: Maitrik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maitrik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Maitrik is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘maitri’ which means ‘friendship’, ‘amity’ or ‘love’. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the name Maitrik is bestowed upon those who possess the qualities of compassion, kindness, and love towards all beings.
